feel drowsy: I always feel drowsy after a big lunch, so it is hard for me to concentrate in the first afternoon class.
我吃完豐盛的午餐後總是感到昏昏欲睡，所以下午第一節課很難專心。
a drowsy afternoon: On a hot, drowsy afternoon, half the students in the classroom were yawning and struggling to keep their eyes open.
在一個炎熱、令人想睡的午後，教室裡一半的學生都在打哈欠，努力撐著不讓眼睛闔上。
make you drowsy: Listening to slow, soft music in bed can make you drowsy and help you fall asleep faster.
躺在床上聽緩慢輕柔的音樂會使人昏沉，幫助你更快入睡。
drunk driving: Drunk driving causes many deadly accidents, so the police stop cars at night to test drivers for alcohol.
酒駕造成許多致命車禍，所以警方晚上會攔車對駕駛進行酒測。
be drunk with power: After he became class president, Kevin was drunk with power and started ordering everyone around.
凱文當上班長後就被權力沖昏頭，開始對每個人頤指氣使。
dead drunk: After drinking a whole bottle of wine at the party, he was dead drunk and couldn't even stand up.
在派對上喝完一整瓶酒後，他爛醉如泥，連站都站不起來。
drunk on success: Drunk on success after her first hit song, the singer stopped practicing, and her next album failed.
第一首暢銷曲之後，這位歌手被成功沖昏頭，不再練習，結果下一張專輯失敗了。
a dumb question: Don't be afraid to ask the teacher; there's no such thing as a dumb question when you are learning something new.
別害怕問老師；學新東西時，沒有所謂的蠢問題。
be struck dumb: When she heard she had won first prize, she was struck dumb and could only stare at the judges.
聽到自己得了第一名時，她驚得說不出話，只能呆望著評審。
dumb luck: I didn't study at all, so passing the test was pure dumb luck; I just guessed every answer.
我完全沒讀書，所以考試及格純屬運氣；每一題我都是用猜的。
play dumb: When Mom asked who ate the cake, my little brother tried to play dumb, pretending he knew nothing about it.
媽媽問是誰吃了蛋糕時，我弟弟想裝傻，假裝什麼都不知道。
durable goods: Durable goods such as refrigerators and washing machines are expected to last for many years.
耐久財，例如冰箱和洗衣機，預期可以使用很多年。
a durable peace: After years of war, both sides signed an agreement in the hope of building a durable peace for future generations.
經過多年戰爭，雙方簽署協議，希望為後代建立持久的和平。
durable materials: These hiking boots are made of durable materials, so they won't wear out even after years of climbing rocky mountains.
這雙登山靴是用耐用的材質做的，所以即使多年攀爬岩石山路也不會磨壞。
a dynamic personality: With her dynamic personality and endless energy, the new teacher quickly made every class exciting and fun.
新老師有充滿活力的個性和用不完的精力，很快就讓每堂課都既刺激又有趣。
a dynamic economy: A dynamic economy creates many new businesses and jobs, attracting young people from all over the world.
有活力的經濟會創造許多新企業和工作機會，吸引來自世界各地的年輕人。
the dynamics of the group: When a new member joined the team, the dynamics of the group changed, and people began working together differently.
有新成員加入團隊後，團體的互動關係改變了，大家開始用不同的方式合作。
a dynamic leader: As a dynamic leader full of fresh ideas, the new mayor quickly turned the quiet town into a lively tourist spot.
身為充滿動力、點子新穎的領袖，新市長很快就把這座安靜的小鎮變成熱鬧的觀光景點。
be eager to learn: The new employees are eager to learn, asking questions all day and taking notes on everything their manager says.
新員工渴望學習，整天發問，並把經理說的每句話都記下來。
be eager for success: Because she is eager for success, she practices the piano eight hours a day and gives up her weekends with friends.
因為她渴求成功，她每天練琴八小時，還放棄週末和朋友相聚。
an eager audience: An eager audience waited outside the stadium for hours, excited to see their favorite band perform live.
熱切期待的觀眾在體育場外等了好幾個小時，興奮地想看最愛的樂團現場演出。
eager anticipation: The children waited in eager anticipation for Christmas morning, counting the days until they could open their presents.
孩子們懷著熱切的期盼等待聖誕節早晨，數著日子直到可以拆禮物。
in earnest: Although he was laughing, I could tell he was speaking in earnest when he said he would quit his job.
雖然他在笑，但當他說要辭職時，我看得出他是認真地在說。
an earnest young man: Grandpa liked my sister's boyfriend, saying he was an earnest young man who worked hard and always told the truth.
爺爺喜歡我姊姊的男朋友，說他是個誠懇認真的年輕人，工作勤奮又總是說實話。
begin in earnest: The rainy season in Taiwan usually begins in earnest in May, when heavy rain falls almost every afternoon.
台灣的梅雨季通常在五月正式展開，那時幾乎每天下午都下大雨。
an earnest plea: The mother made an earnest plea on TV, begging anyone with information about her missing son to call the police.
這位母親在電視上發出懇切的請求，懇求任何知道她失蹤兒子消息的人打電話給警方。
ecological balance: Killing too many sharks can upset the ecological balance of the ocean, because other fish populations will grow out of control.
捕殺太多鯊魚會破壞海洋的生態平衡，因為其他魚類的數量會失控增長。
an ecological disaster: The oil spill was an ecological disaster that killed thousands of seabirds and polluted the coast for years.
這起漏油事件是一場生態浩劫，害死數千隻海鳥，並污染海岸多年。
one's ecological footprint: Riding a bike instead of driving is an easy way to reduce your ecological footprint and protect the planet.
騎腳踏車代替開車是減少你的生態足跡、保護地球的簡單方法。
